coverage_notes:
SOURCES USED (in the order requested):
1. Wikipedia team-season page (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2019_LSU_Tigers_football_team) — infobox, "Coaching staff" table, and the roster-footer staff list. Quotes taken from the roster-footer list render as single lines of the form "Name – Role" (en dash U+2013).
2. LSU athletics staff directory archived on the Wayback Machine at https://web.archive.org/web/20200126232710/https://lsusports.net/staff-directory — captured Jan. 26, 2020, 13 days after the CFP title game (Jan. 13, 2020). This was the ONLY capture of that directory between Aug. 2019 and Jan. 2020 (verified via the Wayback CDX API), so no in-season snapshot exists. For directory rows the visible page text puts the person's name in one table cell and the title in the next, so quotes are the exact name link text and the note records the exact title-column text and the directory category.
3. 2019 LSU Football Media Guide, official PDF at https://static.lsusports.net/assets/docs/fb/pdf/19guide.pdf (published Aug. 12, 2019). Text extracted with PyMuPDF; the support-staff pages (PDF pages 51-54 = guide pages 50-53) are name/title grids, so quotes are single extracted lines (a name, or a one-line sentence fragment from a bio). Every quote was string-verified against the extracted text before being written here.
4. Contemporary news (247Sports, Wikipedia biography pages, Texas A&M staff bio) for people the two staff listings disagreed on or omitted.

KNOWN GAPS AND CAVEATS:
- The Jan. 26, 2020 directory post-dates the title game, so three people who were on staff for the championship are missing from it: Dave Aranda (left for Baylor Jan. 16, 2020), Joe Brady (left for the Carolina Panthers Jan. 15, 2020) and Kenechi Udeze (left for Vanderbilt Jan. 21, 2020). All three are documented via Wikipedia and/or the media guide instead.
- Conversely, the same timing means the directory cannot by itself prove someone was on staff before Jan. 13. David Bowen and Caleb Young are independently confirmed for the 2019 season by outside sources. Forrest Buckner (Recruiting Creative Coordinator) is documented ONLY by the Jan. 26, 2020 directory — I could not find a second source fixing his start date, so his presence at the championship game is probable but not proven.
- Role churn at defensive line: the Aug. 2019 media guide lists Dennis Johnson as Defensive Line Coach. LSU hired Bill Johnson as defensive line coach on Aug. 15, 2019 (before the Aug. 31 opener) and Dennis Johnson moved to an analyst role, which is how Wikipedia and the January directory list him. Both are included with their championship-game roles. Neither change is mid-season, so no midseason_note is set.
- No "quality control" (qc) titles are documented anywhere for 2019 LSU; the program used "Analyst" for those roles, so the qc category is empty.
- NOT ENUMERATED because no source names them: student assistants, recruiting student workers, and the eleven student video assistants referenced in Doug Aucoin's media-guide bio ("Aucoin oversees a staff of 13 people, which includes two full-time assistants and eleven student assistants"). Also not enumerated: the football team's physicians/orthopedic surgeons, who do not appear in either staff listing.
- DELIBERATELY EXCLUDED as athletics-department-wide staff assigned to other sports in the January 2020 directory, even though they appear on the media guide's football "Support Staff" pages: Melissa Moore Seal (Associate Strength & Conditioning Coach, tagged "SB, MT") and Earl Chevalier (Assistant Strength & Conditioning Coach, tagged "GYM, WG"). Also excluded: other Strength & Conditioning staff with no football tag (Greg Goldin, Travis Roy, Chris White, Boo Schexnayder, Jeremy Jacobs, Tim Johnson), other athletic trainers tagged to non-football sports, Shelly Mullenix (Sr. Associate AD/Health and Wellness), Michael Johnson (Executive Chef), and Louis Bourgeois (Director of Athletic Equipment), who is in the department's Equipment Staff category but not on the football media guide's equipment page.
- BORDERLINE, INCLUDED WITH FLAGS: Lauren Marucci, Rebecca Moore, LaKeitha Poole, Bruce Buggs, Christine Sotile and Nathan Lemoine are athletics-department-wide health/performance staff, but LSU printed all six on the football media guide's "Support Staff" page. Their per-person notes say so; filter them out if the ring rule is football-only employment.
- Name spelling conflicts, resolved in favor of the more widely used form and flagged in notes: "DJ Mangas" (directory) vs "DJ Mangus" (media guide); "Jeff Grigus" (media guide) vs "Jeffery Grigus" (directory); "Joe Bourg" (media guide) vs "Joseph Bourg" (directory).
- Total documented: 70 people. Nothing here is inferred or padded; every row carries at least one verified verbatim quote.
